summary: Iteration 2 testing complete: validated header rename + Handover Certificate feature end-to-end across backend and frontend. All 20 pytest cases pass (8 new handover + 12 inspection regression). Frontend Playwright run verified header text, tab switching, handover validation, successful submission with certificate_no, archive display, delete-with-confirm, and inspection regression.

issues: Canvas 2D context emits 'willReadFrequently' warnings on every read; minor, but easy fix is to pass {willReadFrequently:true} to getContext('2d').

action_items: (Optional polish) Pass {willReadFrequently:true} to canvas.getContext('2d') in SignaturePad to silence Chromium warnings.
(Optional) Disable native browser submit on validation failure by also adding aria-live to handover-error for screen readers.
critical_code_review_comments: Soft-fail email path correctly returns email_sent=false when RESEND_API_KEY is empty for both inspection and handover endpoints — no exceptions raised.
Mongo ObjectId is correctly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} on both list endpoints.
Pydantic models use UUID factory for id and HO- prefixed certificate_no factory for handovers — deterministic format (HO- + 6 hex chars uppercased).
Handover form validation in the UI matches backend required fields exactly; no schema drift.
MainApp tab state isolates archives correctly; switching tabs swaps both form and archive as designed.
Toast component disambiguates handover vs inspection via certificate_no presence — clean pattern.
Frontend has data-testid on every interactive element listed in the spec — good testability.
Minor: load_unit testid uses '/' replaced by '-' (handover-load-unit-kN-m2 / handover-load-unit-lbs-ft2) — matches spec, but worth documenting if reused.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed inspections and handovers and clean them up. Post-run cleanup script removed any stragglers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covers: POST/GET/DELETE for /api/handovers, sort-desc verification, site filter, email soft-fail with RESEND_API_KEY empty, unknown-id 404. Frontend covered: PIN 4060 unlock, header 'SAFETY INSPECTION', tab switching (tab-inspection/tab-handover), empty submit shows handover-error, full valid handover submission shows success-toast with 'Handover Certificate Issued' + HO- certificate + client + site, archive renders handover-record-{id}, delete with window.confirm dialog handler removes record, inspection regression still works. Use page.on('dialog', ...) for window.confirm during delete.
rca of the issue: No issues found requiring RCA. One non-blocking observation: while reading toast text immediately after submitting the second (inspection) form, the previous handover toast text can still be present in DOM until React re-renders; tests should wait for textContent to change rather than asserting immediately after click.
